articles.titleOriginal: Boonson, Yu take MVP honors at 2026 Asian Games
articles.titleJa: Yu Boonsonが2026年アジア競技大会でMVPを受賞
articles.summaryJa: タイの短距離走者プリポール・ブーンソンと中国の水泳選手ユー・ジディが2026年アジア競技大会の男女最優秀選手に選ばれたと、アジアオリンピック評議会が日曜日に発表した。
articles.summaryOriginal: NAGOYA - Thai sprinter Puripol Boonson and Chinese swimmer Yu Zidi were named the men's and women's Most Valuable Players of the 2026 Asian Games, the Olympic Council of Asia announced Sunday. Boonson won the men's 100m and 200m titles and took silver in the mixed 4x100m relay. The 20-year-old clocked an Asian Games record of 9.90 seconds in the 100m, becoming the only finalist to break the 10-second barrier.

articles.summaryOriginal: President Lee Jae Myung on Sunday ordered a thorough investigation into recent data breaches at financial institutions, as AI-powered cyberattacks increasingly targeted them. Cheong Wa Dae said he was briefed on the incidents and ordered officials to devise countermeasures. The breaches spread from major banks to nonbank lenders, prompting regulators and police to respond. President Lee Jae Myung speaks during a public event in Sejong, Friday. Joint Press Corps

articles.titleOriginal: Police officer arrested over AI-generated sexual deepfakes
articles.titleJa: AIが生成した性的なディープフェイクで逮捕された警察官
articles.summaryJa: ソウルの東大門警察署の警察官は、Telegramを通じて性的に搾取的なディープフェイクを生成して配布した疑いで9月16日に逮捕されました。警察によると、彼は知人の400人以上の明示的なディープフェイクを作成するためにAIを使用し、軍隊で奉仕している間2年以上活動を続けたという。
articles.summaryOriginal: A police officer at Dongdaemun Police Station in Seoul was arrested Sept. 16 for allegedly generating and distributing sexually exploitative deepfakes through Telegram. Police said he used AI to create more than 400 explicit deepfakes of people he knew and continued the activity for more than two years while serving on the force. Investigators also found thousands of illicit images and videos in his possession. A police officer has been arrested last month for allegedly generating sexually exploitative deepfakes of people he knew with the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and sharing them on Telegram, police said Sunday.

articles.titleOriginal: Nation tops Asian Games table for 12th time
articles.titleJa: Nationがアジア競技大会のテーブルで12回目のトップを獲得
articles.summaryJa: 愛知・名古屋アジア競技大会が日曜日に閉幕したため、中国は過去12回連続でトップの座を維持し、金メダル獲得数で新たな記録を樹立し、新世代の有望な中国のアスリートを世界に紹介しました。
articles.summaryOriginal: China retained the top spot for a record 12th consecutive time as the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games drew to a close on Sunday, creating another record with the number of gold medals won and introducing to the world a new generation of promising Chinese athletes.

articles.titleOriginal: Serving up an ace cultural experience
articles.titleJa: エースの文化体験を楽しもう
articles.summaryJa: 深遠な文化に触れずに旅行することは、決して完全なチャイナオープンの経験ではありません。テニスのトップスターたちは、北京の豊かな歴史と伝統を吸収するために、厳しいシーズンからの休憩を楽しんでいます。
articles.summaryOriginal: A trip without a dip into the profound culture is never a complete China Open experience, and tennis' top stars are enjoying a break from the grueling season to soak up Beijing's rich history and tradition.

articles.titleOriginal: Seoul concludes North Korea responsible for DMZ mine explosions
articles.titleJa: ソウル、北朝鮮が非武装地帯の鉱山爆発に責任があると結論づける
articles.summaryJa: 統合参謀本部副議長のクォン・デウォン中将は、9月21日にソウルの国防省で行われた非武装地帯での地雷爆発を調査するタスクフォースの最終的な調査結果を発表した。
articles.summaryOriginal: Lt. Gen. Kwon Dae-won, vice chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, announces the final findings of a task force investigating a Sept. 21 land mine explosion in the Demilitarized Zone at the Ministry of National Defense in Seoul, Monday. Yonhap South Korea said on Monday that North Korea was responsible for land mine explosions that injured three of its troops in the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) last month, adding the incident was caused by mines recently planted by the North.

articles.titleOriginal: 'Even BTS served in military': Debate reignites over athletes' service exemption privilege
articles.titleJa: 「BTSでも軍隊に勤務」：アスリートのサービス免除特権をめぐる議論が再燃
articles.summaryJa: 韓国の選手の兵役免除に関する議論は、愛知・名古屋アジア競技大会の男子サッカー決勝に続いて選手たちが発言した後、再燃した。この論争はスポーツを超えて政治や世論の批判にまで広がり、特権を廃止するよう新たに求められている。
articles.summaryOriginal: Debate over South Korea’s military service exemption for athletes has reignited after remarks by players following the men’s football final at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. The controversy has spread beyond sports into politics and public criticism, with renewed calls to abolish the privilege. Critics argue the system is increasingly hard to justify amid fairness concerns and shrinking military manpower. Korean men's football team players and coaching staff pose after winning the gold medal in the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games at Toyota Stadium in Aichi Prefecture, Japan, Saturday. Yonhap
